requirement_vague: Password reset should reject new_password with 7 characters with a 422 validation error.

omissions.description: There is no POST /api/v1/reset-password/ endpoint in the code. The password reset functionality is entirely absent.
omissions.reasoning: Searching the entire codebase, there is no route defined for /reset-password/ or any password reset flow. The only password-related endpoint is PATCH /api/v1/users/me/password, which requires authentication and handles current+new password changes, not token-based password reset.
